title: Amazing service
text: Great experience. The staff were very friendly and helpful. Everything was so professional. They were always on time and provided  excellent service throughout the entire trip. The tour guides, the driver, and all staff were like family and did everything so professionally. I enjoyed every moment with them and will definitely repeat this trip again with them. I will definitely recommend them to anyone who is interested in the trip.

title: We had an excellent guide who was Ahmed who explained in detail the history and every space of this wonderful place
text: We already had our trip to Granada but we didn't have the tickets to the Alhambra, they were waiting to get them and immediately advised us.
author: mar_aofelias2022

title: An exciting, highly educational tour.
text: A fantastic tour, led by an extremely gifted guide, Sherif. A PhD student, he was well versed on history, and deftly translated and explained the Arabic verses on the "talking walls" of the Palaces.
author: michaellG2060IA

title: Wonderful tour
text: Tour guide was incredibly knowledgeable about La Alhambra - pointed out things that we never would have seen otherwise
author: KathyBarnes

title: Private tour with luxury guide
text: We decided our last minute Granada getaway. Fortunately they managed to get us the tickets! Our guide, Ahmed, a luxury. PhD student with great knowledge and willingness to share data of great interest. It really paid off! I recommend them
author: Masilv

title: An unforgettable experience largely by the guide (Eva)
text:
A 100% recommended experience, especially if the guide is Eva, in one morning she becomes your friend, your best teacher, your debate partner (political, ecclesiastical, economic.....it dominates everything both architecture , history , gardening.....a pleasure with talkers like that!
The beautiful visit, with a hypnotic setting, and with its explanations full of historical content, legends, curiosities and so on; becomes an unforgettable day.
Thank you very much Eva a pleasure to meet people like you, we will see you again.
author: monicamS211VJ

title: Special day at the Alhambra
text: We had a very special tour of the Alhambra with Ahmed who had an incredible knowledge and love of the Alhambra. A delightful guide, specialist in Arabic inscription who brought this magical place to life.
author: FranklinMelvin_B

title: Amazing trip and an all-around treat.
text: The journey was fun, taking you to the history of the glorious ancestors and civilization that was the world's kiss at the time, the guide, Mr. Ahmed Mehdi, was a peak in ethics and professionalism, and of a broad culture in that history, adding a genuine treat to the journey, the driver on the journey also and his wife deserve to be thanked for their commitment and respect. Though I have a lot of trips, this one is the best of the best, and thank you very much for all the team that helped make it happen.
